title: Employer Group Contracts Segment Schedule: Size Bands, Situs States and New-Business Terms
content:
Employer Group Contracts are written in six size segments of the Cascade Group Dental & Vision series. The segment that applies to a group is fixed by the number of eligible employees it has, and each segment carries its own lead time for a new group application.

## Size bands and application lead times

| Segment | Fewest eligible employees | Most eligible employees | Application lead time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 | 2 | 19 | 15 calendar days |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 | 20 | 49 | 15 calendar days |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 50-99 | 50 | 99 | 30 calendar days |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 | 100 | 249 | 30 calendar days |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 | 250 | 999 | 45 calendar days |
| Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus | 1000 | 0 (no maximum) | 60 calendar days |

In the "most eligible employees" column a value of 0 means the segment has no maximum.

## Terms common to every segment

| Term | Value in all six segments |
|---|---|
| Day of the month on which new contracts and changes take effect | Day 1 |
| Employee census required to quote and issue | Yes |
| States where Cascade issues group contracts (situs states) | WA, OR, CA, AZ, NV, ID, UT |
| Initial contract term | 12 months |

## Meaning of each schedule entry

- **Fewest and most eligible employees**: the smallest and the largest count of eligible employees for the segment.
- **Application lead time**: the number of calendar days before the requested effective date by which a complete group application must be received.
- **Effective day**: the day of the month on which new contracts and changes take effect.
- **Census required**: an employee census is required to quote and issue the contract.
- **Situs states**: the list of states where Cascade issues group contracts.
- **Initial contract term**: the length, in months, of the contract's initial term.

## Reading the bands (hypothetical counts)

The band limits are counts the segment contains, so each band includes both of its end figures and the six bands meet without a gap:

| Hypothetical eligible employees | Segment containing the count |
|---|---|
| 19 | Cascade Group Dental & Vision 2-19 |
| 20 | Cascade Group Dental & Vision 20-49 |
| 249 | Cascade Group Dental & Vision 100-249 |
| 250 | Cascade Group Dental & Vision 250-999 |
| 1000, or any larger count | Cascade Group Dental & Vision 1000 Plus |

Hypothetical lead-time illustration: for a group in the 250-999 segment requesting an effective date on the first of a month, the complete application must be received 45 calendar days before that first of the month; for a 2-19 group the same date needs the complete application 15 calendar days before it.
